question: A can do a piece of work in 15 days, but with the help of B, he can do it in 9 days. In what time can B do it alone?
solution:
**Given:**

A can do a piece of work in 15 days, but with the help of B, he can do it in 9 days.

**Formula used:**

If A take x days to complete work alone and B takes y days to complete the same work alone and A and B together take z days to complete the same work, then (1)/(z)=(1)/(x)+(1)/(y) 

**Calculation:**

Let B alone can do the work in x days.

Then, (1)/(9)=(1)/(15)+(1)/(x)

Solving for x,

(1)/(x)=(1)/(9)-(1)/(15)=(15-9)/(15×9)=(6)/(135)=(2)/(45)

Therefore, x = 45/2 = 22.5 

**∴ B alone can do the same work in 22.5 days.**
